name: Szank (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue in the ratio 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szank: a white shield with a green plant and black ermine-like spots, above a white scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
